# CG split manifests `split_v1` (generated by scripts/hgo/cg_split.py)

Sessions: 34 CG-test / 137 train of 171 trainval sessions (stratified by city, seed 0, test fraction 0.2); navtest = 46 further sessions. Conflict: an agent whose trajectory crosses the ego path, PET < 3.0 s, ego reaches the conflict point within 6.0 s; left / right = turns inside an intersection (road bends = 'curve').

Training pool: 84390 windows from 988 logs = 79111 navtrain + 5279 conflict frames added (one per 2 frames). navtrain tokens dropped with the CG-test sessions: 23283.

Extra test frames (CG-test sessions): 5071 from 265 logs. Metric cache still to build: 65412 training + 4189 test frames.
